Jules (People Ops): Hey team  thanks for the live Q&A today. Opening this thread for any remaining questions about hybrid policy, travel approvals, offsites, and desk booking. I'll collect answers and post a one-pager later. :spiral_notepad:

Aditi (Eng): Quick: if Iook a 3-day customer trip to NYC, do I need both manager + finance okay?

Jules (People Ops): Manager approval is required for any trip. Finance approval only if estimated spend > $2k or if special arrangements (e.g., client-paid hotel billing). Use the TravelForm (link in #people-ops) to auto-route.

Liam (Sales): Can we use spend from event budget for customer dinners during an offsite? Example: using part of the offsite budget to host a small customer dinner.

Ivy (Finance): Yes, events and customer-facing meals can draw from event budgets with receipts and guest list. If drawing from a different budget, note it on the Offsite Form so we tag the ledger properly.

Aditi (Eng): What's the recommended timeline for offsite planning? We want a 2-day sprint + 1 social day.

Diego (Office Ops): Aim for 812 weeks lead time for venues, 4 weeks for domestic catering. Book travel once the venue is locked. We can help shortlist venues if you share headcount + accessibility needs.

Jules (People Ops): Also: equality note 3 if some folks can't travel, teams should budget a remote participation option (video + co-facilitation). Include remote access plan in the Offsite Request.

Liam (Sales): Are there per diem caps for meals on travel days?

Ivy (Finance): We use reasonable expense rules. For US domestic travel, meals up to $75/day are generally okay; for high-cost cities, include justification. Always keep receipts over $25.

Aditi (Eng): For hybrid work: if I'm usually remote but visiting a hub for two weeks, do I need to update HR/People Ops?

Jules (People Ops): Please update your location in the HR portal and mark Slack status. If you're in another country for more than 14 days, we need to discuss tax/visa implications. Ping me before extended stays.

Diego (Office Ops): Desk pooling note: hubs have 20% reservations for visiting teammates. If you need guaranteed seating for >2 weeks, reach out and we'll look at temporary assignment.

Aditi (Eng): Any COVID/vaccine guidance for international travel? Company reimburses required tests/vaccines per policy?

Jules (People Ops): Company covers required tests and vaccines for approved business travel. If destination requires quarantine, check with People Ops before booking as that may affect approval.

Liam (Sales): If customer reimburses hotel directly, how do we handle corporate card vs personal card?

Ivy (Finance): If customer is billing hotel directly, note that on the expense and attach the customer invoice. Do not charge corporate card unless pre-cleared. If you used a personal card, expense as usual and include proof.
